flawed_step: Step 3: Infer that a path minimizing the shifted cost w(P)+c|P| also minimizes the original cost w(P). This is unjustified because candidate paths can have different numbers of edges, so shifting can change their relative costs.
assessment_summary: Step 1: Adding c makes every edge weight nonnegative. Step 2: Dijkstra therefore finds a path minimizing shifted cost. Step 3 fails: subtracting c per edge recovers the original cost of the returned path, but does not establish that this path was shortest under the original weights.
